args.lesson: Verdict PURSUE_IF. The Apify PPE docs give the formula profit = 0.8*revenue - platform costs, and free-plan users are excluded. At USD 0.005 per file, break-even is about 288 s billed per file at 256 MB, so per-event margin is not the risk; volume and paid-plan share are. What worked: fetching the official monetization doc page plus a regex snippet extract gave quotable terms in 2 calls. Gaps: runtime was not measured, and actor.json sets no memory limit. Next time, fetch the developer monetization docs (not only the buyer pricing page) at idea-verdict time, and set memory limits before the first build.
